sar.narrative: Suspicious Activity Report for CASE-006 involving card-not-present fraud on card SC-03006-K944. Four unauthorized transactions (4012154, 4012155, 4012156, 4012157) totaling $454.42 were identified. Real-time monitoring scored transaction 4012154 at 0.82 risk, triggering investigation [EV-fbf11f1a]. Transaction velocity analysis revealed four online transactions within 48 hours, significantly exceeding the card's historical average transaction amount of $104.17 [EV-01cb8eea, EV-04c327c5]. The device fingerprint (Samsung SM-G973F) was previously associated with confirmed fraud case CC-4315 [EV-168bcde4]. Customer SC-03006 reported no authorization of the disputed transactions and confirmed physical card retention [EV-156318f2]. Pattern matching identified six prior card-not-present fraud cases with similar characteristics [EV-e9da25a2]. The customer has one prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4315) on record [EV-ce73e69b]. The investigation concluded with a fraud verdict and fraud probability of 0.835. No connected card IDs were identified in this incident. The exposure amount of $454.42 represents the total disputed transaction value. Recommend continued monitoring of the device profile and customer account for potential recurrence.
